reviews.author: Airneri's Channel
reviews.text: I've used Frank's twice on our rental property. He showed up within a day of both of my emergency plumbing leaks and his prices were reasonable! Very trustworthy and reliable guy! Definitely worth a try if you have plumbing issues that needs quick attention.

reviews.author: Casey Smith
reviews.text: Frank is the best in the business! Replaced my water heater in a timely manner. Very good cost and quality that beats out any big name companies. He was very flexible on scheduling and was available the next day. Totally my go to guy and would recommend to anybody for plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Heather Cutrer
reviews.text: Frank arrived same day and was able to repair the issue quick! He was here for maybe 2 hours and I was back to using my hot water with no leakage. He was very friendly and worked with me to keep things affordable.

reviews.author: Lynda Repsher
reviews.text: Frank's was sent to my house through my home warranty company for replacement of my kitchen sink faucet & garbage disposal. He came to my house once, to look @ problem & to collect the service fee. He left saying he would let me know when he could return to do repairs. After repeated calls to him & home warranty company, I moved on & hired another company to come in & do repairs. I had been without water @ kitchen sink for 2 weeks. To date, have not received refund of service fees.

reviews.author: Katie Mauney
reviews.text: This man is a scammer. He was dispatched by Choice Home Warranty to fix a leak in my sink. He told me he would be back to fix it. It has now been almost a month since he looked at it. Today he was supposed to come fix it and he didn’t show up. When I called him he sent me to voicemail. I called Choice and he lied and said that I didn’t call him and he said that he changed the time to Friday and that he tried contacting me which was also a lie. He just wants to collect the $100 service fee and do no work. Stay away from him and if Choice dispatches him ask for another service provider.
